observed_evidence: repeated web requests containing SQL injection indicators
automated SQL injection tooling identified by user-agent
analyst_interpretation: activity is consistent with SQL injection probing
observed requests do not by themselves prove successful exploitation

analyst_guidance: Review web server and application logs for corresponding errors.

Review the source IP across other web applications and hosts.
